pairs.summary: ASCL1 and ZIC4 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 11 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; ...). Median lift 1.52x, typical spacing ~50 bp between sites. In 10 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. It is enriched in most profiles, so it may reflect general sequence composition of accessible DNA rather than context-specific cooperation. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
